github.title: GitHub identity
github.loadFailedDetail: Paperclip could not verify this agent's current connection. Your existing setup was not changed.
github.dedicatedDetail: Used only by {{agentName}}. This dedicated connection takes precedence over the responsible person's GitHub.
github.useResponsibleDetail: At run start, Paperclip uses the personal GitHub connection of the person responsible for the task.

apps.title: Installed apps
apps.description: Installed apps load tools into {{agentName}}'s context on every run. Permitted-only apps do not add context cost.
apps.banner: Has access means the app is permitted. Installed means its tools are added to this agent's runtime context.
apps.empty: No permitted apps yet. Bind an access profile to make apps available here.
apps.installedForAllHint: Installed from the app page for every agent. Remove the all-agents install there.
apps.loadedHint: Loaded into this agent's runtime context.
apps.permittedNotInstalled: Permitted but not installed — tools will not appear in runs.

effective.title: Effective access
effective.before: This is exactly the tool set Paperclip will accept for
effective.middle: . Profile and policy edits are reflected within ~5 seconds. The agent's prompt can narrow this list but
effective.after: — everything else is blocked by default.

allowed.title: Allowed tools
allowed.empty: No tools are allowed for this agent. Bind a tool profile to grant access.

why.title: Why these tools?
why.noProfiles: No active profile applies to this agent, so it has no allowed tools.
why.noPolicies: No enabled policy currently mutates this agent's allow list.
why.allAllowed: Every known tool this agent could name is allowed.
why.wouldBlock: Tools the agent could name but Paperclip would block:
